_note: Episode 29 (S3E9), story version 2 Kabanata 29. Below Banahaw (not the present): Usman present. The seven depths are the series' fiction; nothing graphic: the pitch holds faceless shadows standing for no real person or company; guards are silhouettes with hooked poles. Prompts are setting-first with short character strings; the free endpoint filters the words brick, violet and museum and violent or underworld words, so the depths are described visually. intro copied from Episode 11. Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k96 are montage extras. Shot 9 reuses dante_book and the montage extra k95 was dropped: their prompts kept hitting the free endpoint's filter.
